# Vendored uPlot

Source: https://github.com/leeoniya/uPlot (MIT)
Version: 1.6.30
Files:
  - uPlot.iife.min.js  — IIFE build; attaches `uPlot` to window
  - uPlot.min.css      — default stylesheet (overridden by css/ui/charts/uplot-theme.css)

Upgrade:
  curl -L -o uPlot.iife.min.js https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/uplot@<version>/dist/uPlot.iife.min.js
  curl -L -o uPlot.min.css    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/uplot@<version>/dist/uPlot.min.css
